tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App and dashboard background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, list groups, balance cards, admin panels.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the OTP digit box, inputs, table header rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and sections. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary buttons, inputs, toggles off). Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, labels on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: vault
tokens.usage: The brand green. Primary action fill, active state, 'Settled' and 'Shared'. As text on any surface or vault-soft.

tokens.name: vault-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind vault text: Settled and Shared badges, selected friend chip.

tokens.name: on-vault
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a vault fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Vault hardware accent: the card chip, the OTP countdown bar, cover blocks. A fill only, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brass-ink text: the Pending badge.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brass-soft (Pending) and on brass fills.

tokens.name: lent
tokens.usage: Money owed TO you (you lent it). Amounts prefixed '+' and labelled 'owes you'. As text on any surface or lent-soft.

tokens.name: lent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind lent text: the Confirmed badge, lent summary chips.

tokens.name: owe
tokens.usage: Money YOU owe. Amounts prefixed '−' and labelled 'you owe'. As text on any surface or owe-soft.

tokens.name: owe-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind owe text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (delete card, revoke share) and the Disputed badge. Never for money you owe — that is owe.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / switch-access focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface and card face.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet (OTP request, share card).

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Liquid-glass chrome that floats over content: the tab bar, nav bar, lock chip, glass buttons. Always with backdrop blur-glass. ink / ink-muted on it hold 4.5:1 even over black or white content.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Glass for dense content: bottom sheets (OTP request, share card), menus. Backdrop blur-sheet.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: The 1px rim of every glass surface. Decorative: glass is set apart by blur and shadow-glass, not by this edge.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Specular top edge of glass — an inset 1px line along the top.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Vault-tinted lens inside glass: the selected tab pill, a pressed glass button. Text on it is vault.

tokens.name: card-onyx
tokens.usage: Card face. Same in both themes — a card looks like a card.

tokens.name: card-jade
tokens.usage: Card face.

tokens.name: card-brass
tokens.usage: Card face.

tokens.name: card-slate
tokens.usage: Card face.

tokens.name: on-card
tokens.usage: Card number, nickname and network on every card face (≥7.5:1).

tokens.name: on-card-muted
tokens.usage: Small labels on a card face ('Valid thru', holder) — ≥5:1 on every face.

tokens.name: card-tag
tokens.usage: Translucent pill on a card face behind on-card text ('Shared with Rahul').

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on a screen: net balance on Vault, the admin's top figure.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles and the amount on a ledger header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rahul gets the card details, encrypted to his phone.

styles.name: card-number
styles.usage: Card numbers on card faces and in detail views, always in groups of four.

styles.name: otp
styles.usage: The OTP in the share sheet, split 3+3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge glyph gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between stacked lines of a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; gap between cards in a stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on mobile; card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; card-face padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Admin page margins; top of empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs, the card chip, table rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, card faces (ISO card corner at 320px), panels, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; admin stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, avatars, friend chips, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Card faces only — they are the one physical object in the app.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets. Everything else is flat, separated by line.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Lifts glass chrome off the content beneath (tab bar, glass buttons, sheets).

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii for the glass material; use as backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-glass)) saturate(180%).

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Tab bar, nav bar, chips and glass buttons.

tokens.name: blur-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and menus, where content beneath must fully dissolve.
